params.summary: Explore stage complete for PR #832/#81 spec review (candidate f7d525ca, baseline 3bb81b9). Read claims.md, the full baseline-to-candidate source.diff (1050 lines), and targeted source regions (episode_semantic_verifier._repair wiring, episode_protocol.strip_evidence_ordinals grammar, episode_tools._finance_query_failure_result, finance_query.validation_diagnostic, research_progress API). Wrote seven independent pytest probes covering all six claims: C5 pagination (absolute row/sample identity, offset/next_offset in scope rows + telemetry + observation text, final-page truncation hint, projection-failure must not register a history read, with a successful-read control proving registration normally happens), C6 dangling-count repair (real SemanticEpisodeVerifier exit: surviving definition and its live count stay visible while the orphaned count and deleted definition disappear, unrelated prose and line breaks preserved, numeric gate still redacts a novel comparator number in the same draft, precondition tests proving removal only happens when the definition was rejected in this pass and has no surviving definition, N条 exemption scope sampled from the claim grammar), C1 ordinal masking (citation grammar vs lookalikes/real quantities, plus citation prose surviving while numbers are checked), C2 safe structured diagnostics for validation/runtime errors with secret-echo checks, C3 same-episode repair feedback with evidence retention, tool-budget non-extension and cancellation, C4 frozen nested Mapping progress without mutation with typed rejection of unknown objects. All assertions are unconditional (no if-wrapped empty passes); test expectations were derived from the claims and traced through the implementation, not copied from author tests. Borrowed fixtures are limited to pre-existing scaffolding (episode _frame/_context/_finish_turn, history _registry, verifier _judge/_structural) and are disclosed per file. No tests were executed in this stage, so no claim is marked verified; the probes and the author suites must run in the execute stage before any verdict beyond STAGE_COMPLETE.
